sources.summary: Dezeen Showroom: a series of rugs that foreground weaving patterns and fibres over colour and print are among six new products featured on Dezeen Showroom. Meridian rugs by Armadillo Rug brand Armadillo has released a collection of rugs named Meridian, which celebrate the tactile effects created by different weave styles, construction methods and fibre types. The post Meridian rugs by Armadillo among six new products on Dezeen Showroom appeared first on Dezeen .
